# **Japan once again wins the Coupe du Monde de la Pâtisserie**
**Jaume Cot**

[Coupe du Monde de la Pâtisserie](https://www.sogoodmagazine.com/tag/coupe-du-monde-de-la-patisserie/)[Sirha](https://www.sogoodmagazine.com/tag/sirha/)

# Japan once again wins the Coupe du Monde de la Pâtisserie
![Japan once again wins the Coupe du Monde de la Pâtisserie](https://www.sogoodmagazine.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/01/podium-cmp2025-1024x512.jpg)

On January 24 and 25, in the impressive Paul Bocuse Hall at the Lyon exhibition center, **the Japanese team won the gold medal** in the [Coupe du Monde de la Pâtisserie](https://www.sogoodmagazine.com/tag/coupe-du-monde-de-la-patisserie/) for the fourth time, ahead of the other 17 participating countries.

![Buffet Japan](https://www.sogoodmagazine.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/01/Japan-sugar-chocolate-sculptures.jpg) Buffet Japan![Buffet France](https://www.sogoodmagazine.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/01/France-sugar-chocolate-esculturas.jpg) Buffet France![Buffet Malaysia](https://www.sogoodmagazine.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/01/Malaysia-sugar-chocolate-esculturas.jpg) Buffet Malaysia
